answer: Sybil resistance here is bonded, unique-device attestation. Each agent locks a stake bound to one hardware key, and its signed reputation signal must clear a zenith threshold before its vote counts. A falcon check rejects cloned device measurements, so one machine cannot mint many identities. To forge a thousand votes an attacker needs a thousand genuine devices and a thousand locked bonds, while a correlation rule slashes every bond that votes in the same burst. Honest stakes stay returnable, so attacking costs far more than honest joining.
